thread:
maria_support: Hey team, customer ACME on Dedicated Private (us-west VPC) reports intermittent 401s on /v1/generate after SSO. They say auth flows succeed (SSO -> SAML -> token issued) but requests hitting our gateway sometimes arrive without Authorization header. Can anyone look?

jason_oncall: Which gateway variant? Dedicated edge or private on-prem? Any repro steps or example request?

maria_support: Private deployment (customer-managed LB -> our gateway pods behind NodePort). Repro curl from customer: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.acme.example.com/v1/generate` -> 401. They ran `tcpdump` at LB and saw header present on TLS-terminated connection. Gateway logs show `missing bearer` and the backend service error is 401.

neha_eng-infra: Do we have the gateway pod logs and the raw request captured by Envoy? Could be an envoy filter or ext_authz rewriting headers. Also curious if LB is doing HTTP/2 to upstream which can mangle header names when converting.

maria_support: Pasted relevant bits from customer (sanitized):
```
# at LB (post-TLS) -> header present
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.acme.example.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
Accept: application/json

# at gateway log -> Authorization missing
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.acme.example.com
Accept: application/json
```

jason_oncall: Which gateway version? deploy-bot, any recent rollouts?

deploy-bot: rollout: gateway-deployment v1.8.3 -> v1.9.0 completed 12:02 UTC (canary 10%).

neha_eng-infra: Hmm v1.9.0 included the new `authn-shim` Envoy filter we added for cookie->bearer rewrite. If misconfigured, it can strip Authorization when it tries to map `sso_assertion` cookie into header. Could explain intermittent because canary only 10%.

carlos_eng: Also check if LB does TCP passthrough (NLB) vs TLS termination. If NLB then ALPN/h2 downgrade to h1 might drop pseudo or custom headers depending on proxy config. But since LB shows header present post-TLS, the loss is between LB and gateway pod. Is proxy protocol enabled? Some setups rewrite original headers into `X-Forwarded-*` and null out original.

maria_support: Customer attached a pcap showing the header present between LB->gateway, but gateway app layer logs show none. They also ran `curl --http1.1` and saw it succeed (200).

neha_eng-infra: That strongly suggests an HTTP/2 path issue. Envoy/istio when receiving h2 can coerce header names into lowercase and sometimes our filter checks for `Authorization` (capital A). The filter code should use canonicalized header names. We'll check the filter logic.

jason_oncall: For immediate mitigation, ask customer to force `--http1.1` on the LB or enable `envoy.downstream_protocol` fallback to http1 in the gateway config; or temporarily route them to a pod running v1.8.3. Maria can you request that?

maria_support: Yes asked ACME to try `--http1.1` and they reported a 200 after switching. They can't maintain that as a permanent fix. They want our fix.

neha_eng-infra: I'll repro locally with gateway v1.9.0 using an h2 upstream to reproduce header loss. Carlos, can you grep the shim filter for `authorization` vs canonical header handling?

carlos_eng: On it. Quick grep shows the filter had `if header == 'Authorization': remove()` in an early review comment; potential bug where it removes before mapping cookie. I'll open a PR to change to case-insensitive match and to not remove until mapping succeeds.

jason_oncall: Good. Also add a debug endpoint to dump raw request headers for private customer deployments so we can validate in-situ without full pcap. Would be helpful for ops.

maria_support: ACME asked for ETA. Any ballpark?

neha_eng-infra: If PR is trivial, we can patch -> smoke test -> promote canary to 50% within a day. I'll coordinate with release to backport to v1.9.0 canary and push hotfix.

carlos_eng: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/5242 — fix header canonicalization + add increased logging behind feature flag.

jason_oncall: Once patch lands, we'll ask ACME to test against patched canary. Also request their pcap and curl verbose output attached to ticket. Maria, can you escalate and open support ticket with priority P1 due to production auth failures?

maria_support: Opening ticket now and attaching pcap + logs. Ticket #SUP-4821. Thx everyone. :pray: 

# end of thread
